text_block_list.text:
December ■ | Post-Race | Wind: 
Sail-Slapping "To the Open Sea!" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I won! I won the Challenge Cup! Both my 
friends and I went wild with joy!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I signed the base lease contract using the 
fountain pen the Navigator prepared for 
today. With this, we've graduated from 
being a rootless pirate crew!!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last, the full-scale push 
toward becoming the best in the world 
begins! However, to race overseas, she 
must pull off a record-breaking run at 
home first.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The target was the Kinko Sho, where 
Silence Suzuka had once raced like a 
swift-sailing ship. There, she would 
rewrite everyone's memories!
